cancellation_summary: Please email the Recreation Department at recreation@paradisepoint.com to inform us of your cancellation.
description:
Enjoy a game of basketball and shoot some hoops under our tropical palms. 

**Reservation is required** 
________________________________
what_is_included: Basketball and basketball court are included for the hour reserved of rental.
what_is_not_included: Water is not included; bringing your own water bottle is highly recommended.
itinerary: Availble daily between the hours of 8AM - 6PM
check_in_details:
Staff will be at the **Island Market** on the hour sharp to hand out equipment.

**Reservation is required** 

**Please note we will wait 10 minutes before you forfeit your reservation and it will be cancelled.**
____________________
what_to_bring: Must be 16 years or older to checkout equipment and a valid Driver's License or ID is required while equipment is in use.
